In the conversations shared, there are instances where Jennifer and Li Hua discuss adjusting their training plans. Specifically, in the second conversation (ID 1), Jennifer mentions she has received feedback from Li Hua regarding their current training sessions, which led her to suggest filling out a survey to gather more insights and improve the training sessions. This indicates that Jennifer is proactive in gathering feedback to enhance the overall training experience. 

Additionally, in the fourth conversation (ID 4), Li Hua expresses concern about balancing work and fitness commitments. He asks if they can adjust the training plan to accommodate his work schedule better. Jennifer responds positively and suggests a modified training schedule where Li Hua trains twice a week, specifically on Tuesdays and Thursdays. This adjustment is aimed at ensuring that Li Hua can maintain a consistent fitness routine without disrupting his work life. Thus, the reasons behind Jennifer and Li Hua's decision to change their training routine involve seeking continuous improvement in the training sessions and accommodating Li Hua's work commitments to ensure his ability to adhere to the program.
